historical_decision.result: top-1 accuracy, 4.0 micrometre per pixel minus 0.5 micrometre per pixel: -0.527 (95% CI -0.541 to -0.513). The fixed ImageNet ResNet-50 with k-nearest-neighbour baseline received the same degraded pixels and lost 29.1% relative; even after retraining it held 0.62 accuracy where CONCH reached 0.28, so the transformed images still carried class information that CONCH used less effectively
historical_decision.attribution: Recorded historical registry summary; not a new reviewer verdict
